meta.name: s3
meta.description: AWS S3 object storage for bucket management, object operations, and access control. Use when creating buckets, uploading files, configuring lifecycle policies, setting up static websites, managing permissions, or implementing cross-region replication.

copy.tagline: 管理 AWS S3 存储桶和对象
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要操作 AWS S3 存储桶和对象。
copy.tagline_en: Manage AWS S3 buckets and objects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with AWS S3 buckets and objects.

howto.what: Claude 可以帮你管理 AWS S3 存储桶和对象，包括创建桶、上传下载文件、设置生命周期策略、配置静态网站、管理权限和跨区域复制等操作。
howto.when: 当你需要管理 AWS S3 存储桶或对象，例如创建桶、上传文件、配置生命周期策略、设置静态网站、管理权限或实现跨区域复制时触发。
howto.what_en: Claude can help you manage AWS S3 buckets and objects, including creating buckets, uploading/downloading files, configuring lifecycle policies, setting up static websites, managing permissions, and implementing cross-region replication.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to manage AWS S3 buckets or objects, such as creating buckets, uploading files, configuring lifecycle policies, setting up static websites, managing permissions, or implementing cross-region replication.

say_en.text: Create a bucket named my-secure-bucket-12345 with versioning and encryption enabled.
Generate a presigned URL valid for 1 hour to download file.txt from my-bucket.
say_en.note: Claude will provide Python code to generate the presigned URL.
